data.name: Ibreez
data.gender_notes: Ibreez is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ibraah', which means 'to breathe' or 'to blow'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the gentle breeze or wind sent by Allah to bring comfort and relief. This name is mentioned in the Quran and has spiritual significance for Muslims. The name Ibreez carries the meaning “Breeze, Wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibreez usually hope their child will grow to embody breeze, wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle breeze sent by Allah, a symbol of His mercy and comfort.
data.etymology: Ibreez belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breeze, Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibreez total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إبريز
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبريز هو اسم يعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى ومعناه الأبدي، وهو اسم يستخدم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الله تعالى ومجده، وقد يستخدم أيضًا للإشارة إلى شيء ما الذي هو غير محدد الزمن، ويعد إبريز من أسماء الله الحسنى التي يرغب المسلمون بتسمية أطفالهم بها، وتعتبر هذه الأسماء ذات قيمة روحية ودينية في الإسلام، ويستند معنى هذا الاسم إلى الجذر الأرامي الأصلي الذي يعني "الإبدي" أو "اللا نهائي"، ويتم استخدامه في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الله تعالى، ويعتبر إبريز من أسماء الله الحسنى التي لها أهمية خاصة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: ایبریز
in_urdu.meaning: ایک اسم الہی جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات سے منسوب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایبریز ایک اسم الہی ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات سے منسوب ہے اور اس کا مطلب انتہائی ابدیت ہے۔ یہ اسم قرآن میں بھی آیا ہے اور اللہ تعالیٰ کی تعریف میں استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ انتہائی ابدیت ہے اور ہر چیز کا خالق ہے۔ ایبریز ایک بہت ہی اچھا اسم ہے جو مسلمانوں کے لئے بہت اہم ہے۔

historical_references.reference: Ibreez is mentioned in the Quran as one of the companions of Moses (Musa) during the exodus from Egypt. He was tasked with carrying the Ark of the Covenant on a raised pole during their journey through the Sinai Peninsula. When the Israelites grew weary, Ibreez and his brother, Hareem, were criticized for their slow progress. In response, they questioned the faith of their fellow travelers, leading to a confrontation and a miraculous intervention by Allah. [https://quran.com/28/24-26]
historical_references.time_period: Circa 13th century BCE (traditional date for the Exodus from Egypt)
historical_references.context: Story from the Quran about the Prophet Moses and the Israelites' journey from Egypt to the Promised Land

historical_references.reference: Ibreez is also mentioned in several hadiths (collections of sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad). In one account, Ibreez and his brother, Nizaa'r, were the first to accept Islam when Prophet Muhammad began preaching in Mecca. They were both members of the tribe of Kalb and were known for their strong faith and dedication to God. [https://sunnah.com/bukhari:5335]
